release_notes: Maya 1.4.7: Help opens a context-help instruction card; the Guide release banner covers 1.4.6 - 1.4.7. LP normals can be preserved before triangulation (enabled by default). Marmoset receives base HP without baked Preview smoothing, supports HP-only/LP-only export and safer synchronization. Subgroup visibility and chapter export exclusions are fixed. Cage editing adds undo-safe adjustments and validated LP/Cage export pairing.
